title: New Horizons original Wisp art handoff
artifactStatus: art-only handoff; candidate descriptor is not runtime-installed or gameplay-certified

sourcePolicy.alpha: Original source files remain byte-identical. In exported pose crops, alpha values below 32 are set to zero to remove the near-invisible background grain observed across the generated atlases; all RGB values and alpha values at or above the threshold are preserved.
sourcePolicy.cropLocalization: Alpha >= 32 locates each authored pose crop; 5px padding is retained so the faint outer corona is not cut. Cleared low-alpha pixel counts are recorded per pose.
sourcePolicy.coreAlignment: Per-pose weighted bright RGB core centroid anchors the cropped source at the fixed logical battle point. No alpha-bound recentering or per-frame scale is used.

geometry.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS for uniform per-atlas battle scaling; BICUBIC for requested faceless-orb rotations; no tween/smear frames.

supplementalAtlasGrid.rowBoundaryReason: authored alpha gutters are uneven; equal 1086/4 cuts clip the upper reaction poses

descriptor.format: VCMI JSON animation replacement candidate: basepath plus zero-based sequences/group/frames
descriptor.timingNote: VCMI animation JSON sequences list frame images but do not carry per-frame durations; durationMs values are handoff metadata for integration review.

adventureDescriptor.format: VCMI JSON animation replacement candidate with one group-0 PNG sequence

previews.zoom: 4x nearest-neighbor from the native close crop

projectile: Omitted here; supplied separately by the root handoff owner.
risks: Some supplemental source poses are tightly arranged near horizontal alpha gaps; per-pose crops are recorded for visual review.
The candidate descriptor and generic groups do not define Wisp abilities, attack type, elemental affinity, movement, or gameplay capability.
Adventure movement/idle animation registration, runtime timing, shadow policy, creature data, and in-game acceptance remain integration work.
